title: Local saves blocked: virtuus list-field validation and getCurrentUser in local mode
description: Found while porting Library/Score to the data layer (574eb9). (1) virtuus-amplify rejects list fields on create/update ('Field tags must be a string'; validation near lib.rs ~2761 ignores isArray), so updating a Slice with tags and domain.saveScore (writes lastErrors: []) fail against apricity serve. Fix upstream in ~/Projects/Virtuus (specs first). (2) web/src/data/auth.ts getCurrentUser() returns null in local mode, so domain.saveScore stops with 'No authenticated user'; local mode should use custom.apricity.identity from amplify_outputs.json. Cloud saves go through real AppSync and are unaffected.
